# Prism Wallpapers documentation index

Use these first-party resources for Prism integration details:

- [API guide](/docs): endpoints, examples, errors, and sandbox notes.
- [API summary](/api.md): compact endpoint overview.
- [OpenAPI](/openapi.json): machine-readable API description.
- [Developers](/developers): integration links and repository.
- [MCP guide](/mcp): Streamable HTTP endpoint and tool configuration.
- [Authentication guide](/auth.md): public access and why agent authentication is not supported.

Public API catalog reads do not require authentication. Check source docs for current service behavior.
